crossRefs.note: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones…
When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

translations.web: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’
translations.bsb: So Jesus declared, “The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those in authority over them call themselves benefactors.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles have lordship over them; and they that have authority over them are called Benefactors.
